playable_promise: You are Dr. Watson at Holmes's side, drawn from a dawn summons into a frightened woman's account of her sister's impossible death, and then into the very rooms at Stoke Moran where you can inspect the shutters, the dummy bell-rope, the ventilator, and Roylott's safe to feel the murderous architecture tighten into a plan for the coming night.

session_budget_decision.budget_reasoning: The Story Session Map fixes 25 minutes and a 10-14 moment range; I adopt 25 minutes unchanged and choose 12 moments. Twelve lets the front-loaded recital (events 92-93, 95, 98) compress into fewer testimony rooms while the authored clue architecture (shutters 105, dummy rope 106, Roylott's room 107, night plan 109) each earns its own breathing room. The Roylott burst-in confrontation (99-100) is too vivid and character-defining to fold away, so it holds one room. Travel (102-103) compresses into a single traversal moment. This gives a brisk but legible investigative arc without starving the source's evidentiary weight.

event_role_map.why: Entry Point start event: Watson wakes under an urgent summons and makes his first load-bearing commitment to the case, expressing his mode of loyalty and inquiry.

The veiled woman, the fire, Holmes's deduction from ticket and mud, and 'It is fear... It is terror' establish the interview room with a live first branch on detachment vs advocacy; compressed but inhabitable.
Helen's account of Stoke Moran, Roylott's violent nature, and the financial settlement is load-bearing motive canon; compressed into probeable testimony rather than monologue.
Must-breathe: Julia's last night, the whistle, the metallic clang, and 'The speckled band' are the originating wound and title image; the player should inhabit the recollection and question it.
The inquest details carry the sealed-room canon and the evidence-discipline vs speculative-leap branch (grounded facts vs the gipsy scent); folded into the testimony's pressure.
Helen's forced move into the death-room and the returned whistle is a sharp ticking-clock image driving the whole session; short beat inside the recollection room.
Must-breathe: the wrist bruises pay off the M02 detachment/advocacy branch and commit Holmes and Watson to Stoke Moran that day; a real relational and decisive beat.
Holmes and Watson's theory recap restates gipsy/band/whistle reasoning already surfaced in testimony; compress into transitional deliberation rather than a full room.
event_role_map.reintroduction_note: Holmes's provisional gipsy-band theory and its self-declared objections carry into the room inspection where they are tested and overturned; the ventilator/bed logic in M11 resolves what the theory left open.

event_role_map.why: Roylott's doorway burst-in, the crocus small talk, and the bent poker is the villain's defining embodied menace and a strong playable pressure room.
Must-compress: Holmes straightening the poker is a single crisp image of composure answering menace; kept as a short beat closing the confrontation.
The will and income arithmetic is the practical-motive-arithmetic canon proving Roylott's strongest motive, plus Watson arming with the revolver; deserves an inhabitable planning beat.
Must-compress: connective train-and-trap travel; render as brief cinematic traversal with the spring-vs-sinister-quest contrast surfaced on interaction.
event_role_map.reintroduction_note: The bright-spring-against-sinister-quest tonal contrast and Holmes brooding in the trap are preserved as ambient traversal detail folding directly into the arrival at the stile.

event_role_map.why: The stile arrival and Helen's greeting confirms Roylott is away, opening the inspection window; short image beat closing the traversal.
Holmes tells Helen he met Roylott and urges immediate inspection; brief pressure beat that turns the group toward the rooms.
Must-breathe: the crab-claw exterior, the needless scaffolding excuse, and the unforceable barred shutters are core sealed-room clue architecture the player must inspect.
Must-breathe: the death-room inventory, the dummy bell-rope over the ventilator, and 'ventilators which do not ventilate' are the authored heart of the mystery; a full inspection room.
Must-breathe: Roylott's room with the safe, saucer of milk, examined wooden chair, and the looped whipcord lash are the decisive clue set; deserves close object inspection.
Holmes's grim insistence that Helen absolutely follow his advice carries the trust-Holmes vs assert-independence branch feeding Session 2's signal timing; short charged beat.
Must-breathe: the night vigil plan, the lamp signal, and Helen's room change is the operational hinge into Session 2; an inhabitable planning room.
Watching Roylott drive past and shake his fists at the lad from the inn confirms his return and menace; sharp observed image opening the final beat.
Must-breathe: Holmes reveals the ventilator/bed/rope deduction and Watson commits to the danger; the session's cash-out of accumulated evidence into a coherent, tense understanding.

Holmes's ticket-and-mud deduction (belongs to next beat)
Any supernatural framing of the case

It seems that a young lady has arrived in a considerable state of excitement, who insists upon seeing me.

the clock on the mantelpiece showed me that it was only a quarter-past seven, I blinked up at him in some surprise, and perhaps just a little resentment
moment_drafts.exit_condition_draft: The central pressure resolves once Watson has committed himself to the case in his chosen mode and is ready to descend to the waiting client, whether dutifully, cautiously, or with insistence on her comfort first.
